lines.text: - name: Remove the review for a closed pull request
- name: Drop reviews older than 30 days
A workflow removes a pull request folder when that pull request closes. Sites older than ${DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS} days are dropped.
A workflow drops sites older than ${DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS} days.

lines.text: `node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr <n>` removes one site; `prune --ttl-days 30` removes every site older than 30 days. `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs both: on pull request close and daily.

`node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr <n>` removes one site; `prune --ttl-days 30` removes every site older than 30 days. `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs the second daily, so a merged pull request's review and evidence stay up for 30 days after their last publish.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml b/.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml
index afda5918..105a2b6d 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml
@@ -1,8 +1,6 @@
 name: Pages reviews
 
 on:
-  pull_request:
-    types: [closed]
   schedule:
     - cron: "23 4 * * *"
   workflow_dispatch:
@@ -28,9 +26,5 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
           git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
-      - name: Remove the review for a closed pull request
-        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
-        run: node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
       - name: Drop reviews older than 30 days
-        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
         run: node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --ttl-days 30
